svg.data-renderer: Matplotlib MathText / STIX; embedded vector paths
svg.title: The Kuratowski obstruction graphs K5 and K3,3
svg.desc: K5 has ten edges, violating the planar simple graph bound three v minus six. K3,3 has nine edges and no triangles, violating the triangle-free planar bound two v minus four.
Figure labels: K₅; v = 5, e = 10; 10 > 3·5 − 6; K₃,₃; v = 6, e = 9; triangle-free; 9 > 2·6 − 4
